intro: Missingness is a property of the mask, not of a particular numeric value. An observed zero contributes to the denominator, while an unobserved large value contributes to neither sum nor count.
task: Compute column counts and means under an explicit observation mask, with a defined empty-column fallback.
requirements: values is a matrix and observed is a boolean matrix of exactly the same shape. fallback is a real scalar.
Return {"count": counts per column, "mean": observed means per column}. Unobserved numeric cells are ignored even if their values are large.
Use fallback only for columns with no observed cells. All numeric cells, including unobserved cells, must be finite.

Unless a requirement explicitly sets another range, numeric inputs are real and finite with magnitude at most 10000. Booleans are rejected except explicit boolean masks. Vectors have length 1..64 and matrix axes 1..64 unless specified otherwise. Leave inputs unchanged. Raise ValueError for invalid types, bounds, shapes or documented domain conditions.

examples.name: Missing observations
examples.output:
{'count': [2, 1], 'mean': [3.0, 8.0]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 10 significant digits.)

examples.name: Empty column
examples.output:
{'count': [0, 2], 'mean': [7.0, 3.0]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 10 significant digits.)

examples.name: All observed
examples.output:
{'count': [2, 2], 'mean': [3.0, 5.0]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 10 significant digits.)

hints.title: Choose the representation
hints.body: Keep the observation mask separate from the numeric measurements.

hints.title: Build the result
hints.body: Sum only selected cells and divide only columns whose count is positive.

explanation: Missingness is a property of the mask, not of a particular numeric value. An observed zero contributes to the denominator, while an unobserved large value contributes to neither sum nor count.
Returning counts alongside means makes coverage visible. The fallback prevents division by zero but does not pretend that an unobserved column has supporting data.
